name: Villanueva de Gómez (Spain)
description: A blue hoist third bearing a pair of white shears between two yellow bells, the fly green with a yellow shield charged with blue roundels laid over a white sword.
history: The descriptions of the arms and the flag were approved officially on 3 April 2008 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 8 of 14 January 2009); the flag is of dimensions 2:3, tierced at the hoist.

features.role: open shears between two yellow bells
shield with blue roundels over a white sword
